newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News confirms sells Fairfax stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News confirms sells Fairfax stake.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said on Friday it could confirm it had sold its shares in newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
"I can confirm that we have sold all our shares in Fairfax," a News spokeswoman told Reuters.
She said she could not comment on when or why the shares had been sold.
Earlier on Friday, newspapers reported broking sources saying News had sold all or almost all its stake in Fairfax over the last six weeks.
Last month News chief executive and chairman Rupert Murdoch said in an interview that he did not want to buy Fairfax.
News had a stake in Fairfax of just under five percent and therefore did not need to issue a notice of a change in substantial shareholding.
